content: Kiitetethi Ehiya Anjo
Neeni Godaa ne Xoossaas polo kiitetiko, hachi ta new immiya kiita ubbaa minthada naagiko, Goday, ne Xoossay biittan de7iya kawotethata ubbaafe aathidi nena dhoqu dhoqu oothana.
Neeni Godaa, ne Xoossaas kiitetiko, haysafe kaallidi de7iya anjo ubbay nebaa gidana.
Ne katamaninne ne goshshan anjetidaysa gidana.
Ne ulo ayfey, ne kathay, ne mehey, ne dorsatinne ne deeshati anjetidaysata gidana.
Ne keesheynne ne munaqa miishey anjetidaysa gidana.
Ne kessaynne ne geloy anjetidaysa gidana.
Ne bolla dendiya ne morketa, Goday ne sinthan xoonetidaysata oothana. Enti ne bolla issi ogera yaana, shin laapun ogera ne sinthafe baqatana.
Goday ne kushey oykiyabaanne ne shaaliya anjana; Goday, ne Xoossay new immiya biittan nena anjana.
Neeni Godaa, ne Xoossaa kiita naagikonne iya ogiyan biiko, I new caaqidaysada Goday nena baw geeshsha dere oothidi essana.
Hessafe guye, biittan de7iya asa ubbay Goday ba sunthan nena xeegidaysa be7idi yayyana.
Goday new immanaw ne mayzatas caaqida he biittan, ne ulo ayfiya, ne mehiya, ne goshsha ayfiya darsidi anjana.
Ne kushe ooso ubbaa anjanawunne, Goday ne biittas ira woden woden bukisanaw ba minja keethaa, salo pengiya new dooyana. Neeni daro kawotethatas gede tal7anaape attishin, oodefeka haa tal7aka.
Goday nena ubbaas kace kessanaape attishin, goyna kessenna. Hachi ta new immiya, Godaa, ne Xoossaa kiita si7ada, minthada naagiko, ne bolla gidanaape attishin, garse gidaka.
Ta new hachi immida kiitaape haddirsi woyko ushachi gada, hara xoossata kaallofa; enta goyinnofa.
Kiitetonna Ixoy Ehiya Baadethi
Shin neeni Godaa, ne Xoossaas kiitetonna ixada, hachi ta nena kiittiya wogaanne higgiya ubbaa naagonna ixiko, haysafe kaallidi de7iya baadethati ubbay ne bolla yaananne nena demmana.
Ne katamaninne ne goshshan baadetidaysa gidana.
Ne keesheynne munaqa miishey baadetidaysa gidana.
Ne ulo ayfey, ne katha ayfey, ne mehey, ne dorsaynne deeshay baadetidaysa gidana.
Ne kessaynne ne geloy baadetidaysa gidana.
Neeni iita ooso oothada tana aggida gisho, neeni eeson dhayana gakanaw ne oothiya ooso ubban Goday baadethi, dagamanne kawushatethi yeddana.
Neeni laattanaw biya biittafe dhayana gakanaw Goday, gadoy neepe duuxonna mela oothana.
Goday nena gilqatethan, mishan, madunthan, xuuggiya awan, koshan, wol7oninne kathi dhaysiya harmen ne dhayana gakanaw shocana.
Neepe bollara de7iya saloy naase birata gidana; neepe garsara de7iya biittay birata gidana.
Goday ne biittan bukiya ira bidonne baana kessana; neeni dhayana gakanaw salope baani bukana.
Goday nena ne morketan xoonisana. Neeni enta olanaw issi ogera keyana; shin laapun ogera ne enta sinthafe baqatana. Biittan de7iya kawotethi ubbay ne bolla gakidaba be7idi, yashshan kokorana.
Ne ahay salo kafotasinne bazzo do7atas kathi gidana; enta yedethiya oonika deenna.
Goday nena paxoy bayna Gibxe gadon, kixan, madunthaninne puuso hergen shocana.
Goday nena gooshshatethan, qooqetethaninne dagaman shocana.
Seeta gallas neeni qooqey tattafeysada tattafana; ne oothiyaba ubbay new giigonna ixana. Ne de7o laytha ubban ne un7etananne bonqetada daana. Nena maaddiya asi demmaka.
Ne macho oycha giigisana, shin iyo hari dafi ekidi iissana. Neeni keethe keexana, shin iyan de7aka. Woyne tokana, shin iya ayfiya maaka.
Ne booray ne sinthan shuketana, shin iya ashuwa maaka. Ne harey neepe wolqan eketana, shin new guye simmenna. Ne dorsati ne morketas imetana, enta ashshanaw nena maaddiya asi deenna.
Ne ayfey be7ishin ne adde naytinne macca nayti hara kawotethas imetana. Enti simmin be7ana gada xeellishin, ne ayfey tollu gidi attana; hessa digganaw new wolqi deenna.
Ne biitta ayfiyanne ne cawa ubbaa ne eronna asi maana; ne de7o laytha ubban un7etidaysanne naaqetidaysa gidana.
Ne be7iya iitati nena gooshshana.
Goday paxoy bayna iita madunthan ne gulbatanne ne wodiriya hargisana; tohope huuphe gakanaw, nena he madunthan shocana.
Goday nenanne ne kawa, nenanne ne mayzata eronna asa biitta efana. Hessan neeni mithafenne shuchafe oosetida hara xoossata goyinnana.
Goday nena laaliya hara kawotethata giddon neeni miichasinne kaassas attana.
Neeni daro kathi ne goshshan zerana; shin booley midigin, guutha kathi shiishana.
Woyne tokada iya harmana, shin guxuney iya midigin, iyape ayfe demmaka woyko iyape uyaka.
Ne biitta ubban shamahoy dolana, shin ayfey qoqofetidi wuriya gisho, shamaho zayte demmaka.
Ne addenne macca yelana, shin oli di77idi efiya gisho enti neera dookona.
Ne mithaanne ne biitta ayfiya booley wursana.
Ne giddon de7iya bete asay ne bolla dhoqu dhoqu gaana, shin ne guye attada ziqi ziqi gaana.
I new tal7anaape attishin, ne iyaw tal7aka; I huuphe gidana; neeni goyna gidana.
Godaa, ne Xoossaa, ne kiitetonna ixida gishonne iya wogaanne higgiya naagonna ixida gisho, ne dhayana gakanaw ha baadethati ubbay ne bolla wodhana; nena enti yedethana.
Ha baadethati ne bollanne ne kochaa bolla merinaw malaatanne malaalsiyaba gidana.
New sa7i injetida wode Godaa, ne Xoossaa ufaysaninne galatan goyinnona gisho,
nena koshan, saamon, kallotethaninne meton ubbaba dhayada, Goday ne bolla yeddiya ne morketas haaretana. Goday nena dhaysana gakanaw ne morgen birata qambara wothana.
Goday ne enta qaala eronna kawotethata, biitta gaxape ankoy piradhidi wodheysada ne bolla ehana.
Enti wozana minota; cima bonchonayisata; naytas qadhetonayisata.
Ne dhayana gakanaw enti ne mehiyanne goshsha ayfiya maana. Neeni dhayana gakanaw ne kathaa, ne woyniya, ne zaytiya, ne miizanne ne dorsa wudiya maarokona.
Goday, ne Xoossay new immiya biittan de7iya ne ammanetiya adussenne mino dirsati laaletana gakanaw ne katamaa yuushuwa teqidi nena un7ethana.
Ne morketi katamaa teqidi nena un7ethiya wode miyaba dhayada, Goday ne Xoossay new immida ne ulo ayfe gidida ne adde naytanne ne macca nayta maana.
Ne giddon hari attoshin kase injen de7ida asika ba ishaas, ba dosiya machesinne ba yelida naytas ba kathaafe shaakenna.
Morketi katamaa teqidi un7ethiya wode maanabay hari bayna gisho, miya ba nayta ashuwape hara oodeska immenna.
Ne giddon kase injen de7ida, ba injiyafe dendoysan sa7a yedhanaw shaatetiya maccasiya, ba dosiya azinaasinne ba yelida naytas uuzettana.
Morketi iya de7iya katamaa teqidi iyo un7ethida gishonne waaysida gisho, iw hari miyabay dhayin, ba yelida na7aanne do7aa enta gathonna geeman barka maana.
Ha maxaafan xaafetida higgeta ne naagonna ixiko, malaalsiyanne yashshiya Godaa, ne Xoossaa suntha bonchona ixiko,
ne bollanne ne kochaa bolla Goday, yashshiya gado, daro wode gam7iya, paxoy bayna iita harge yeddana.
Kase Gibxe asaa bolla be7ada, ne yayyida Gibxe harge ubbaa zaaridi ne bolla ehana; he hargey nena yeddenna.
Gujidika, ha higge maxaafan xaafetiboonna hargetanne gadota ubbaa ne dhayana gakanaw Goday ne bolla ehana.
Godaa, hinte Xoossa hinte si7onna ixida gisho, salo xoolintoda darida hintefe guuthi attana.
Goday, hintew lo77oba oothiya wodenne hinte tayboy dariya wode ufaytidaysada ha77i hinte bolla gado ehiya wodenne hintena dhaysiya wode ufaytana; hinte laattanaw biya biittafe shodetidi dhayana.
Goday nena ha gaxape ya gaxa gakanaw kawotethata ubbaa giddon laallana. Yan neeni woyko ne mayzati eronna hara mithinne shucha xoossata goyinnana.
He kawotethata giddon hinte shempo demmeketa; tohoy yedhiya bessika new deenna. Yan Goday new qofan kumida guugge, amon argaacida ayfenne ufaysi qanxida wozana immana.
Ne de7oy hirgan kumana; gallasinne qamma dagamaninne hayqo yashshan un7etada daana.
Ne wozanan kumida yashshaafenne ne ayfey be7iya palabaape dendoysan, wontiya wode neeni, “Awude qammandeesha” qassi qammiya wode, “Awude wontandesha” yaagana.

Ta nena, “Zaarada ha ogiyara baaka” gida ogiyara Goday nena zaaridi markaben guye Gibxe yeddana. Yan neeni aylle gidanaw ne morketas nena bayzanaw koyana, shin hintena aylleyanaw shammiya asi demmeketa.
